about: Shared cases for round 32, written by the browser simulation. The Windows app must give the same answers.

guideSteps.title: What this is
lines: ANDA Companion (Notula) shows a short card for an ANDA number you select in an email or a document: the goal date, the forecast, what needs you, and your notes.
It starts with sample data so that you can try it. Every sample record is fictional, and its card says so.
Nothing leaves this PC unless you switch a connection on, or press a button that says it goes online.

guideSteps.title: Try it on a sample
lines: Select an ANDA number in any window, then press {shortcut}. Or press the button below to open the card of the sample ANDA 216482.
On the card, Enter starts a note of your own and Esc closes the card.

guideSteps.title: Use your own data
lines: In Settings, under “My files and writing”, choose your portfolio file (Excel or CSV). The card then shows your ANDAs, and says where the data is from and how old it is.
The file is read on this PC. Nothing from it is sent anywhere unless you switch a connection on, and the app copies it only if you ask it to keep a weekly copy.

guideSteps.title: What is switched on
lines: Settings and the app's other large windows say at their foot what is switched on. At the moment: {connections}
No AI is used until you choose a connection in Settings. “Connections and event log” lists what each connection sends, where to, and what is kept.

guideSteps.title: Where things are
lines: Click the tray icon near the clock to open Today: what needs a look, the ANDAs you keep, and the recent ones. Right-click it for the menu, which holds Lookup, Review a draft, Connections and event log, Backups and archive, and Settings.
This guide is there as well, under “Help: first steps”. Notices and the tray dot appear only while the app is running.
